title: session-load's rss_mean_mb averages each class over only the samples it was alive in, so means are not comparable across classes and arms
goal: Every rss_mean_mb row of session-load is the mean over all sampler ticks of its phase (or arm B's window), a tick with no process of the class counting as 0, so a class's mean never exceeds the 'all' mean of the same phase and arm, and arms can be compared; the docs say what the mean is over

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A,B', '--reps', '1',
                    '--out', out], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
mean = {(r['case'], r['arm']): float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load' and r['metric'] == 'rss_mean_mb'}
for (case, arm), v in mean.items():
    phase, cls = case.split(' ', 1)
    if cls == 'all' or ' ' in cls:
        continue
    whole = mean.get((phase + ' all', arm))
    assert whole is not None and v <= whole + 1e-6, ('a class mean exceeds the all mean of its phase and arm: the means are over different samples', case, arm, v, whole)
